lines.text: LORELEI: Welcome to the Pokémon League!
Oh, looks like you finally made your way here.\nIt sure took you a while, though!
...Well then, allow me to reintroduce myself.\nI am Lorelei of the Elite Four.
No one can best me when it comes\nto icy Pokémon.
Freezing moves are powerful. Your Pokémon will\nbe at my mercy when they are frozen solid.
That’s because frozen Pokémon can’t do\na thing in battle!

LORELEI: Looks like you’ve gotten stronger since
we last met!\c
Go on ahead.\c
You only got a taste of
the Pokémon League’s power.

LORELEI: Welcome to the Pokémon League!\c
Hey, fantastic timing! I was just thinking how
I’d like to battle you.\c
I hope you’re ready.

LORELEI: I may have lost to you, but I’ll never
give up on my Ice-type Pokémon!\c
You should aim to win using Pokémon you like
best, too!
